{{Quote|Yes, yes, what is it, P'Lor?"<br />"A message, sir. A scrambled emergency transmission for the Rebels from someone named 'Leia.' Shall I have them return?|Orion Ferret and P'Lor|<ref name="marvel59" />}}
'''P'Lor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] who served as an aide to [[Orion Ferret]], the owner and operator of the black market [[Space station/Legends|space station]] ''[[Bazarre]]'' during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], P'Lor aided Ferret in his attempt to swindle and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] over a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] deal. However, their plot was foiled in part due to the help of their [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] friend [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="marvel59" />

==Behind the scenes==
P'Lor appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 59|''Star Wars'' 59]], written by [[David Michelinie]], illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="marvel59" />
